calibration_notes: Reviewed baseline headings, captions, tables, formulas, prompts, prose and bibliography as supplied in Markdown. Page layout, graphic contents, appendices, primary research traces and source publications were unavailable for independent inspection.

Record 19 was withdrawn. Preserve antarperiode. Preserve quoted instructions and machine-readable artifacts exactly, including the quoted semicolon. Records 12–16 address single-item prose, code definitions and glossary placement. Case notation is explained in §3.1. Front matter is outside this file. Records 17, 21–24 and 26 concern formatting in the final rendered document.

Historical comments calibrate review. Proposed after-text has no established acceptance status. Records 2 and 36–40 praise concrete cases, precision at thresholds and detailed comparisons. Records 40 and 104 overlap on wording, so keep the substance of the praised repetition account.
The Chapter IV comparison pattern serves three different aggregation questions. The presence of repeated syntax or uniform success does not by itself warrant rewriting every subsection.
A declared procedure or observed agent action is reported as the manuscript describes it. No inference about unseen execution traces or universal document reading is warranted.
